Start with small moments, like a walk without music or a cup of coffee without a screen. Give your brain space to breathe, and you’ll notice how much more creative, focused, and happier you become.

Boredom isn’t the enemy—it’s an ally. It challenges you to reflect on who you are and what you want. So put your phone away, let your thoughts wander, and embrace the silence. Your brain will thank you.
